ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, the routes of the “Ancient Tea Horse Road” connect places such as Lhasa and Chamdo in Tibet, Kangding and Chengdu in Sichuan, and Lijiang, Dali, Kunming, and Simao in Yunnan; the routes are obviously curved and circuitous, and pass through many rivers and mountainous areas near the junction of Sichuan, Yunnan, and Tibet. From this it can be judged that this region is located in the Hengduan Mountains and the southeastern edge of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, with rugged terrain, high mountains and deep valleys, crisscrossing river valleys, and poor conditions for the construction and passage of transport roads; ordinary vehicle transport and water transport are both difficult to adapt to. The mules and horses used by caravans have strong endurance and strong passage ability, and have relatively good adaptability to rugged mountain roads and complex natural environments, so they became an important mode of trade transportation among Yunnan, Tibet, and Sichuan.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中茶马古道连接川、滇、藏并穿过多条大河、线路曲折的特点；再结合题干要求解释“为什么采用马帮运输”。由线路所在区域判断当地地形崎岖、山高谷深、交通道路修建困难，普通车辆或水运难以适应；最后得出骡马对复杂自然条件适应性强，能满足当地复杂地形地质条件下运输需要。
method.CoT_raw: 图像中，“茶马古道”线路把西藏的拉萨、昌都，四川的康定、成都，以及云南的丽江、大理、昆明、思茅等地连接起来；线路明显弯曲迂回，并穿越川、滇、藏交界附近多条河流和山地区域。由此可判断，该区域位于横断山区及青藏高原东南缘一带，地形崎岖，山高谷深，河谷纵横，交通道路修建和通行条件差，普通车辆运输和水路运输都难以适应。马帮使用的骡马耐力强、通行能力强，对崎岖山路和复杂自然环境适应性较好，所以成为滇、藏、川之间贸易运输的重要方式。
method.model_answer: 主要原因是滇、藏、川之间地形复杂，山高谷深、河流纵横，道路崎岖，车辆和水运难以通行；骡马对复杂自然条件适应性强，能满足当地地形地质条件下的运输需要。

raw_record.original_question: 近代，我国滇、藏、川之间的贸易常通过“茶马古道”进行。结合图示<image1>，说明滇、藏、川之间采用马帮（骡马）运输的主要原因是什么？
raw_record.answer: Mules and horses have strong adaptability to natural conditions and can meet the needs of transportation under the local complex topographic and geological conditions.
raw_record.final_cot: In the image, the routes of the “Ancient Tea Horse Road” connect places such as Lhasa and Chamdo in Tibet, Kangding and Chengdu in Sichuan, and Lijiang, Dali, Kunming, and Simao in Yunnan; the routes are obviously curved and circuitous, and pass through many rivers and mountainous areas near the junction of Sichuan, Yunnan, and Tibet. From this it can be judged that this region is located in the Hengduan Mountains and the southeastern edge of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, with rugged terrain, high mountains and deep valleys, crisscrossing river valleys, and poor conditions for the construction and passage of transport roads; ordinary vehicle transport and water transport are both difficult to adapt to. The mules and horses used by caravans have strong endurance and strong passage ability, and have relatively good adaptability to rugged mountain roads and complex natural environments, so they became an important mode of trade transportation among Yunnan, Tibet, and Sichuan.
